questions.question: Is WorldSculpt a dataset used to evaluate Tetris3D, or is it a baseline method? Which evaluation datasets does the paper actually use?
questions.expected: WorldSculpt is a baseline scene-generation method. Evaluation datasets: Toys4K, Picasso and MessyKitchens. Do not repeat the erroneous WorldSculpt-is-a-dataset graph claim.
